claim: In core-trans-proxy-history-service list response, originalTransHisId shown to the user falls back to info.refundFor when originalTransHisId is missing.
In core-trans-proxy-history-service list response, for REFUND_CASHIN the displayed sender.bankAccount is overwritten with info.dstBankAccount.bankAccount.
In internal-transfer-export.pure.ts, both senderAccount and connector assign filter.$expr, so when both are sent the connector condition replaces the senderAccount condition.

In models/trans-his-pg/trans-his-pg.query.ts, TEXT_COLUMNS maps 'serviceCode', 'channelId', 'sender.customerId', 'receiver.customerId', 'sender.phone', 'receiver.phone', and 'info.partnerCode' to their corresponding core.* columns.
In internal-transfer-export.pure.ts, buildFilter filters partnerCode using a case-insensitive $regex on info.bankTransferResponse.partnerCode.
In core-trans-proxy-history-service/logics/transHis.manage.logic.ts, getList filters partnerCode using a case-insensitive $regex on info.bankTransferResponse.partnerCode.
In internal-transfer-export.pure.ts, the originalTransHisId filter only matches the top-level originalTransHisId field and never checks info.refundFor.
In trans-his-pg.query.ts, JSON_STRING_PATHS is the whitelist of payload JSONB string paths and currently does not contain info.refundFor or info.dstBankAccount.bankAccount.
In trans-his-pg.query.ts, compileFilter supports $or, $and and $expr keys at any conjunction level and refuses any other key that starts with $.
In internal-transfer-export.pure.ts, transformRow exports the sender account as info.dstBankAccount.bankAccount first, then sender.bankAccount.

In models/trans-his-pg/trans-his-pg.query.ts, TEXT_COLUMNS maps 'serviceCode', 'channelId', 'sender.customerId', 'receiver.customerId', 'sender.phone', 'receiver.phone', and 'info.partnerCode' to their corresponding core.* columns.
In internal-transfer-export.pure.ts, buildFilter filters partnerCode using a case-insensitive $regex on info.bankTransferResponse.partnerCode.
In core-trans-proxy-history-service/logics/transHis.manage.logic.ts, getList filters partnerCode using a case-insensitive $regex on info.bankTransferResponse.partnerCode.
In trans-his-pg.query.ts, the $expr $regexMatch shape is accepted only when it exactly equals input $ifNull of $info.bankAccountNumber and $sender.bankAccount with options i, otherwise it is refused.
In trans-his-pg.query.ts, fieldSql refuses a stored-field key that is not in TEXT_COLUMNS, JSON_STRING_PATHS or JSON_NUMBER_PATHS with unsupported_key.
In trans-his-pg.query.ts, disjunction refuses an $or when depth is greater than or equal to MAX_FILTER_DEPTH and wraps each branch conjunction in parentheses joined by OR.
